root_idea.summary: The root centers on distinguishing one thing from another and making it distinct or manifest.
root_idea.development: Its central notion develops from physical separation and division into departure, weaning, partitioning and clarification, and finally decisive judgment; related nouns preserve ideas of joints, boundaries, sections, and separating elements.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural active participle is presented under its singular participial citation form.
The Quranic feminine plural adjective is a form of the same passive participial lexeme and is presented under the singular citation form.

senses.definition: To go forth or depart from a place or person.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive movement-away use; the Quranic occurrences describe setting out or departure.

senses.definition: To decide or judge between people, claims, or opposing positions.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with a between-phrase or an object of judgment; the decision distinguishes what is true from what is false.

senses.definition: To make distinct, clear, or detailed; to explain by setting something out in separate portions.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic Form II use concerns clarifying signs, rulings, accounts, or other matters, including their detailed exposition; active and passive constructions express the same branch.

senses.definition: A man's nearest kindred or close kin-group.
senses.usage_conditions: A kinship group closely attached to and supporting a person; the Quranic usage refers to such near kindred.

senses.definition: A decision or judgment that distinguishes truth from falsehood; the decisive judgment.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage it commonly denotes the Judgment or Day of Decision, when distinctions and judgments are made between people.

senses.definition: Decisive, clear, or discriminating speech or judgment.
senses.usage_conditions: Describes a statement or ruling that is unambiguous and separates what is true or correct from what is false or erroneous.

senses.definition: One who separates, decides, or makes a discriminating judgment.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle referring to a person or other agent that decisively distinguishes between opposing matters; the Quranic plural refers to deciders.

senses.definition: The weaning of a nursing infant.
senses.usage_conditions: The separation of the child from breastfeeding; the Quran also uses it in reckoning the period of bearing and weaning.

senses.definition: Made distinct, clear, or detailed; set out in separate portions.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle or adjective describing signs, scripture, or other matters whose parts have been clarified, differentiated, or explained in detail.

senses.definition: The portion of the Quran known as al-Mufassal.
senses.usage_conditions: A technical Quranic designation for the portion whose chapters are marked by many divisions; its reported starting point varies among authorities.

senses.definition: Detailed explanation or clear setting out of something.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun of Form II, referring to the act or result of explaining, clarifying, or presenting matters in detail.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate, divide, or put one thing apart from another; to make a separation between two things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive separation or division, including making a boundary between two lands or a division among people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a vine, to put forth small grapes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place a separating bead between each two beads of a string.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of arranging beads or pearls with intervening separators.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide something into distinct portions or parts; to cut it into sections.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes dividing a carcass into limbs and cutting cloth for a garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate oneself from a partner with the partner's concurrence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or mutually agreed separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become separated or divided and put apart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive separation or division.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth or away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive departure use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To transplant a palm-tree by removing it from its place of growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A separation, division, or partition between two things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun of separation, including a dividing boundary or interval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place of articulation or joint between two bones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use referring to a bodily joint.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of the divisions or seasons of the year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as the singular of the divisions of the year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A section or division of a chapter or book.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A textual or structural division distinguished from other sections.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A branch of a lineage or relationship, contrasted with its ancestral stock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A genealogical use contrasting branches with origins.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A widespread plague or pestilence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A transplanted young palm-tree removed from its place of growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The young palm is understood as removed from its mother-tree or original growth-place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young camel after being weaned from its mother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can also be extended to a young camel generally and, less commonly, to a young bovine animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low wall or enclosure-wall in front of a fortress or city wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A defensive wall standing before the principal wall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use in which the form has the sense of something separated or cut off.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female young camel, the feminine counterpart of a فَصِيل.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of flesh from the thigh or another limb of the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use for a separated portion of flesh or limb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who praises people excessively in order to obtain gifts from them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet described as adventitious rather than indigenous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A loquacious man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate epithet use for talkativeness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A complete cut or severance between two persons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A decisive and completed separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A judge, arbiter, or arbitrator.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative intensive designation for one who decides judicially.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bead, gem, or other separator placed between beads in a necklace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separating element distinguishing adjacent beads or groups of beads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A final word or ending that separates and marks the verses of the Quran; also an ending in rhymed prose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural فَوَاصِل is used for verse-final divisions and comparable prose endings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A joint or articulation where two bones or limbs meet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes bodily joints such as the elbow, knee, knuckle, or phalangeal articulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The point on which an affair turns or its utmost particular point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in the expression for tracing an affair from its hinge or decisive point.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place between mountains or between a mountain and sandy terrain, often associated with a clear watercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical and topographical use with several closely related descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation of the tongue as an instrument by which matters are distinguished and clarified.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A necklace arranged with separators between successive beads or groups of beads.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing a necklace whose beads are divided by intervening beads, gems, or gold pieces.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Inflectional and pointer material without an independent meaning.
Grammatical terminology, despite its Quran citation.

cautions: Lane Quran citations retain historical citation conventions and have not been converted into modern verse locations unless independently confirmed by QAC.
The Quranic plural active participle فَاصِلِينَ is normalized under the singular citation form فَاصِلٌ; the feminine plural adjective مُفَصَّلَات is likewise grouped under مُفَصَّلٌ.
The technical boundaries reported for the Quranic portion called al-Mufassal vary among the cited authorities.
